gate_type: CORRECTION gate (Issue #94 SA comment 5645448466): narrow completion of C02-3 - artificially created water must fail physical conservation, real discharges must be bounded by available water, and the LINE2 process loss must be the declared law plus a modelled spill. No config/contract/architecture/topology/control expansion; no C2, T107, UI, PIM or ASSY work; no merge.
sa_decision_ref: Issue #94 comment 5645448466 (SA counterexample: initial water 0, external input 0, external output 1 m3 still reported conserved because _shortfall_m3 was subtracted from the residual) - required base c3e7893adeead308cce72ac2a76ba24b497d6bdb, same C01 branch / PR #96
architecture_authority_ref: VF-SHW-X2 + X2-C01/C02 report/evidence; the canonical session/bridge/run authority and the frozen X1 contract layer are unchanged
objective: Make the plant water oracle physically honest: (1) keep created water visible as a diagnostic but never use it as a reconciliation term - any non-rounding artificial water creation fails physical validity/conserved/PASS, with accounting reconciliation clearly separated from physical conservation; (2) bound every real discharge (transfer withdrawal, backwash wash water, sludge processing, wash return) by the water actually available so no scope emits unavailable water and repairs storage with a clamp, with explicit diagnostics when the bound binds; (3) test the SA counterexample and a real zero/near-empty filter forced backwash, asserting created water stays within a justified rounding tolerance on every accepted scenario; (4) prove the LINE2 process loss equals the declared loss law plus the explicitly modelled capacity spill, with a negative mutation check proving an arbitrarily dropped delivery is not valid process loss; (5) propagate physical-validity failures into the evidence verdicts so a reconciled residual alone can never yield PHYSICAL_ORACLES_SATISFIED.
explicit_non_objectives: No change to any frozen X1 config/contract (configs/** stays untouched)
No new scope, edge, topology, controller, control class or fidelity class
No new physical assumption beyond bounding an existing discharge by available water
No C2 activation, no PI/PID dynamics, no T107
forbidden_paths_note: tests/ is intentionally NOT listed as a whole-directory forbidden entry: the C03 corrections are covered by the existing X2 module (single-file allowlist). configs/, contracts.py, x2_controls.py and session.py are forbidden: C03 is confined to the physical model (bounded discharges + loss audit) and the oracle/report/evidence surface.
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/shwtp/whole_plant.py (bounded discharge helper + bounded wash-out/withdrawal with explicit diagnostics; physical-vs-accounting conservation split with created water as a diagnostic only; declared LAW + capacity-spill process loss with an audit)
tests/test_vnext_x2_whole_plant_runtime.py (C03 counterexample, dry-filter forced backwash, bounded-discharge proof, created-water tolerance per scenario, LINE2 audit + negative mutation)
required_smoke_checks: Canonical baseline green at the pushed head
Full suite green at the pushed head
forbidden_actions: Subtracting created water from the residual to certify physical conservation
Emitting water a scope does not hold and repairing the storage with a clamp
Relabelling an arbitrary dropped delivery as valid process loss
Increasing any percentage tolerance instead of accounting a modelled loss
Changing frozen config/contract, topology, controls or the session/lifecycle identity
stop_conditions: A fix would require a genuinely new physical assumption (report BLOCKED FOR SA before choosing it)
A fix would require changing a frozen X1 config/contract or the frozen topology
Bounding a discharge would silently change accepted process behaviour beyond the invalid state

acceptance_criteria.description: Created water (shortfall) stays visible as a diagnostic but is never a reconciliation term: the SA counterexample (0 initial water, 0 input, 1 m3 output) reports conserved=false / physical_valid=false, and the report clearly distinguishes physical conservation from accounting reconciliation

Every real discharge is bounded by the water actually held (+ inflow) with explicit diagnostics; no scope emits unavailable water and repairs storage with a clamp, and a dry filter driven through a forced backwash creates no water
Every accepted scenario keeps created water within the justified rounding tolerance (not merely >= 0) and reports physical_valid=true

The LINE2 process loss equals the declared loss law plus the explicitly modelled capacity spill on every accepted window, and a negative mutation (an arbitrarily dropped delivery) is rejected by the audit
Evidence verdicts propagate physical-validity failures: a reconciled residual alone cannot produce PHYSICAL_ORACLES_SATISFIED or PLANT_WATER_CONSERVED_ON_WATER_ONLY
No frozen config/contract, topology, control, session/lifecycle or UI surface changed; focused regression, canonical baseline and full suite are green at the pushed head
